eps.o: Dax tries to get Team RoboGobo to agree on how to stop a fish-stealing Gimme Pig.
Shelly and Wingo try to prove they are responsible by pet-sitting crabby Crabitha.
RoboGobo must rescue a flock of sheep from Mönkey Wrënch.
When Gimme Pig takes over the Heads 'n Tails Salon, Allie and Booster set aside their differences to rescue everyone.
Pupsicle convinces Shelly that Wingo is no longer her best friend.
The team saves RoboGobo-super fan raccoons, Risky and Royale, from a runaway parade balloon.
When Pupsicle freezes a bird bath, RoboGobo must rescue Bob Beaks' flock of birds.
Dax and Wingo must get back the team's Robo-Suits from Gimme Pig.
Dax and Booster help Crabitha learn to let go when she and Pupsicle get in a tug-of-war over pizza.
To save a pig lost inside Monkey Wrench's hideout, RoboGobo helps Hopper focus.
Dax helps Booster stop The Slink from going invisible and ruining a birthday party.
When Mönkey Wrënch creates a noisy problem, Allie must be brave to save the day.

eps.t: A Hop on the Wild Side
eps.o: When RoboGobo visits the Wild Side, Hopper learns how to tie a knot to save a cub.
After Dax uses his mum's invention, he and Booster must rescue Crabitha from a skatepark.
Dax, Allie and Hopper save Gimme Pig from a giant water wheel.
Mönkey Wrënch takes away Team RoboGobo's ability to communicate.
Dax and Allie help a firefly overcome her fear of the dark.
Hopper must rescue a prickly porcupine from a bouncy house.
Gimme Pig uses a giant claw machine to steal prizes at the arcade.
Dax helps Allie become a super cowgirl when they visit Farmer Faye.
Risky and Royale pretend to be in danger so Team RoboGobo will rescue them.
Dax and Allie meet a jaguar cub with limb difference.
Hopper and Booster rescue a family of foxes.
When The Slink tries to ruin art, Shelly learns to paint what she feels.
When Pupsicle freezes the Groundhog Day party, Gus the Groundhog helps Allie discover her silly side.
Wingo learns patience to outsmart The Slink.
The Slink and Gimme Pig get stuck together.
Booster must learn to be calm around bees to stop Gimme Pig.
Dax and Booster help a lizard get his prize medal back from Gimme Pig.

eps.t: When You Wrench Upon a Star
eps.o: Monkey Wrench plans to disrupt the team's campout.
When a friendly tarantula scares people at the pet adoption, Dax and Allie must help him find a forever home.
Booster and Dax team up with Risky and Royale to stop Mönkey Wrënch.
Hopper keeps his promise to care for a rare egg, even when Gimme Pig steals it.
Gill the goldfish flees his vet check-up.
On Father's Day, Dax reunites a lost baby elephant with her dad while waiting to spend time with his own dad.
Booster struggles with giving away his old blankie.
When the Slink tricks Risky and Royale into joining her crew, RoboGobo must rescue them.
Dax and Hopper help a scared penguin go down a slide to escape Pupsicle's Mecha-Muttsicles.
RoboGobo and Park Ranger Pep help a platypus find a home.
When Mönkey Wrënch causes trouble at the Roller Rink, Team RoboGobo must rescue a hamster in a runaway hamster ball.
On a rainy day, RoboGobo must quietly capture a cricket before it wakes up Dr. V's pet patient.
Dax and Booster stop the Slink from stealing the main role in a play.
When Pupsicle wakes a frozen Mammoth, Shelly uses her smarts to save the Ani-Mall.
When Mönkey Wrënch swaps the team's Robo-Suits, Dax teaches the hero pets to adapt to the change.
Dax and Booster follow clues into a big hay bale maze to catch a sneaky snack thief.
RoboGobo saves a scared bat and stops the Slink from haunting MetroPet Island.
Hopper's family fun night plans keep getting interrupted when baddies show up with plans of their own.
When all the baddies team up, RoboGobo must become Robo-Jumbo to stop them.
